senses.sense_definition: Verse melk waarvan de melksuiker nog niet door fermentatie is omgezet in melkzuur.

examples.text: In de winkel kun je kiezen tussen <w>zoetemelk</w> en zure karnemelk.

target_lang_translations.en: In the store, you can choose between <w>fresh milk</w> and sour buttermilk.
target_lang_translations.tr: Mağazada <w>taze süt</w> ile ekşi yayık altı suyu arasında seçim yapabilirsiniz.

examples.text: Veel mensen drinken 's ochtends graag een glas verse <w>zoetemelk</w> bij het ontbijt.

target_lang_translations.en: Many people like to drink a glass of fresh <w>fresh milk</w> with breakfast in the morning.
target_lang_translations.tr: Pek çok insan sabahları kahvaltıda bir bardak <w>taze süt</w> içmeyi sever.

target_lang_definitions.en: Fresh milk that has not yet undergone fermentation, meaning the lactose has not been converted into lactic acid.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Fermentasyon yoluyla laktik aside dönüşmemiş, taze ve tatlı süt.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Standard, non-fermented milk as opposed to sour milk or buttermilk.
A literal translation often used in specific regional or historical contexts to distinguish from sour milk.

tr.target_lang_sense_clarification: Fermente olmamış, günlük içilen normal süt.
Ekşimiş sütten (karnemelk) ayırt etmek için kullanılan geleneksel terim.
